attempts.answer:
<thought>This is a Regulation M-style BSS format, so I'm building a balanced team around the strongest legal threats: Garchomp and Dragonite as physical sweepers, Gholdengo as a special attacker and spin-blocker, Kingambit as a late-game cleaner, Rotom-Wash for defensive pivoting and Intimidate support, and Mimikyu as a fast setup sweeper with Disguise to guarantee a free turn. The team covers each other's weaknesses well and offers multiple win conditions for the bring-6-pick-3 format.</thought>

Dragonite
Gholdengo
Kingambit
Rotom-Wash
Mimikyu
</pokemon>

attempts.answer:
<thought>Garchomp and Dragonite (with its Mega Stone) are the physical core, with Gholdengo as a bulky Nasty Plot special attacker and Kingambit as a Supreme Overlord cleaner. Rotom-Wash provides defensive pivoting and burn support, while Mimikyu uses Disguise for a guaranteed Swords Dance turn. EVs are capped at 32 per stat/66 total, so I max speed and the primary attacking stat on each and patch bulk with the remainder.</thought>

attempts.reasoning:
Build sets. Note EV limit: 32 max per stat, 66 total — unusual. So EVs like 32 Atk / 32 Spe / 2 HP.

Garchomp: Swords Dance, Earthquake, Dragon Claw/Scale Shot, Fire Fang; Rough Skin; Life Orb or Muscle Band... item clause. Give Garchomp Life Orb? Dragonite wants Multiscale + Dragonite item? Dragonite (item) exists — "Dragoninite" mega stone? Dragonite isn't listed... "Dragoninite" is in list! But Dragonite mega? Actually Dragonite has no mega normally; but Champions format—Dragoninite listed, so Dragonite can Mega Evolve. Give Dragonite Dragoninite, Multiscale, Dragon Dance, Extreme Speed, Earthquake, Ice Spinner/Outrage.

Gholdengo: Nasty Plot, Make It Rain, Shadow Ball, Recover; Leftovers? Give Air Balloon not available. Leftovers.

Kingambit: Supreme Overlord, Kowtow Cleave, Sucker Punch, Iron Head, Swords Dance; Black Glasses.

Rotom-Wash: Volt Switch, Hydro Pump, Will-O-Wisp, Protect; Leftovers taken—Sitrus Berry or Mystic Water. Give Sitrus Berry.

Mimikyu: Swords Dance, Play Rough, Shadow Sneak, Shadow Claw; Life Orb taken—use Ghostium? Not available; use Spell Tag or Fairy Feather. Spell Tag boosts Shadow Claw/Sneak; better: Life Orb on Mimikyu and Garchomp Muscle Band? Give Garchomp Soft Sand? Better: Garchomp Life Orb, Mimikyu Spell Tag... or Mimikyu Focus Sash? Disguise already. Use Mimikyu Spell Tag.

EVs: 32 Atk / 32 Spe / 2 SpD style.
